items.raw_excerpt: The Geltwood shipwreck has long been part of the Limestone Coast's history. A documentary is giving it new life.
items.summary_en: A new documentary tells the story of the Geltwood, a ship that wrecked off South Australia's coast in 1876 on its maiden voyage from England.
